name: Alluna
source: Alluna was a bit luckier in the powers department, and she was blessed with the power of the moon. She fights with divine based abilities, and can do everything from punching enemies with staggering force to leaping across the room in an instant. She's a damned good fighter too, which just makes Brie feel even more useless. Even though there's a massive difference in their skill levels, the two girls are great friends, and have been ever since they went to highschool together. But fighting tentacle monsters is stressful work, and there's bound to be some bumps in the road. Especially when there's guys involved...
